title: STORMGUIDE-FL: Stochastic Remote Guidance for Efficient Mining of Federated Streaming Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.20975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices ("clients") while preserving data privacy. However, real-world deployments involve clients that observe continuous data streams from evolving environments while operating under strict resource limitations. Existing solutions still face two major challenges: local concept drift, where each client's data distribution shifts over time, and global client drift, arising from asynchronous engagement and imbalanced contributions across heterogeneous training participants, formally described as dual client heterogeneity. We propose STORMGUIDE-FL, a federated optimization and data-mining framework that mitigates both types of drift using a server-guided pipeline for data acquisition and local training. translated_title: STORMGUIDE-FL：用于高效挖掘联邦流式数据的随机远程引导
translated_abstract: 联邦学习能够在保护数据隐私的同时，实现跨分布式边缘设备（“客户端”）的协作式模型训练。然而，在现实世界的部署中，客户端需要在严格的资源限制下，观察来自不断演化环境的连续数据流。现有解决方案仍然面临两大挑战：局部概念漂移，即每个客户端的数据分布随时间发生偏移；以及全局客户端漂移，它源于异构训练参与者的异步参与和不均衡贡献，可被正式描述为双重客户端异构性。我们提出STORMGUIDE-FL，这是一个联邦优化与数据挖掘框架，通过服务器引导的数据获取与本地训练流程来缓解这两类漂移。在数据获取方面，一种轻量级的客户端采样策略从非平稳、非独立同分布（non-IID）的本地数据流中增量式地选择信息丰富且多样化的实例……
tldr: 提出STORMGUIDE-FL联邦优化与数据挖掘框架，通过服务器引导的数据获取与本地训练流程，结合轻量级客户端采样策略，同时缓解联邦流式数据挖掘中的局部概念漂移与全局客户端漂移（双重客户端异构性）。
en_tdlr: STORMGUIDE-FL is a federated optimization and data-mining framework that mitigates both local concept drift and global client drift via a server-guided pipeline for data acquisition and local training, using lightweight client-side sampling from non-stationary, non-IID streams.
